zh.headline: Bun 团队用 Claude Code 在 9 天内重写 100 万行代码，引发安全性质疑
zh.observation: 今天的核心信号是 **AI 产业正在从"能力竞赛"转向"信任与安全竞赛"**。Bun 用 Claude Code 重写百万行代码后引发的安全性质疑、微软软件包二次被凭证窃取器污染、以及 Meta 被迫删除面部识别代码，都在提醒行业：AI 的规模化落地必须建立在可信任的基础之上。与此同时，OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的 IPO 竞赛与 Apple WWDC 的 AI 全面升级表明，资本和产品两端的竞争都在加速——但谁能在安全与速度之间找到平衡，谁才能赢得下一个阶段。

items.title: OpenAI 秘密提交 IPO 申请，紧随 Anthropic 之后
items.desc: OpenAI 已向 SEC 秘密提交 S-1 表格，距其主要竞争对手 Anthropic 提交上市申请仅过一周，两大 AI 巨头上市竞赛进一步加剧。
items.value: AI 产业资本化加速，两大头部公司争夺公开市场先机。

items.title: Bun 团队用 Claude Code 在 9 天内重写 100 万行代码，引发安全性质疑
items.desc: Bun 项目通过 6755 次提交完成史上最大规模 AI 重构，但 99.8% 测试通过率是否代表真正的代码安全引发开发者社区激烈讨论。
items.value: AI 代码重构的极限案例，暴露测试覆盖率与安全性的鸿沟。

items.title: Apple WWDC 2026 发布全新 Siri AI 与 Apple Intelligence 升级
items.desc: Apple 在 WWDC 上推出基于 AI 的全新 Siri，支持更自然的对话、个性化上下文理解，并宣布为小型开发者免除云端 AI API 费用。
items.value: Apple AI 战略全面落地，降低开发者门槛，加速生态内 AI 应用。

items.title: Google NotebookLM 升级至 Gemini 3.5，新增云端计算机与来源检索
items.desc: NotebookLM 全面升级至 Gemini 3.5 模型，响应更准确可靠，并加入云端计算能力和辅助查找来源的新功能。
items.value: AI 笔记工具能力跃升，从被动问答转向主动研究助手。

items.title: 微软 AI 负责人称超级智能即将到来，但不会取代你的工作
items.desc: Mustafa Suleyman 在采访中表示超级智能已近在咫尺，但人类工作不会被完全替代，强调人机协作的未来。
items.value: 顶级 AI 高管对 AGI 时间线的判断及对就业影响的权威观点。

items.title: 蚂蚁集团推出海外 AI 支付解决方案，支持全球智能体运营
items.desc: 该方案可协助用户与商家判断智能体的可信赖程度，为 AI 代理的商业化支付铺平道路。
items.value: AI 代理经济的支付基础设施，解决信任与结算的核心问题。

items.title: 高德发布 ABot-Earth0.5：3D 原生驱动的高一致性场景生成模型
items.desc: 该模型跨越 2D 蒸馏模式，以 3D 原生方式实现高一致性场景生成，已正式开放内测。
items.value: 3D 场景生成从 2D 蒸馏走向原生 3D，提升自动驾驶仿真等场景的真实性。

items.title: 英国政府投资十亿美元 AI 超级计算机，欲摆脱对美国科技的依赖
items.desc: 英国政府认为国家支持的算力基础设施将助力本土芯片初创企业崛起，减少对美国技术的依赖。
items.value: 全球 AI 算力竞争加剧，各国加速本土化布局。

items.title: Meta 从其智能眼镜应用中删除面部识别系统
items.desc: 在 WIRED 报道后，Meta 从最新版 Meta AI 应用中移除了面部识别代码，但未说明原因或是否会恢复。
items.value: AI 隐私监管持续收紧，面部识别技术面临更严格审查。

items.title: 微软软件包再次被凭证窃取器污染，已是数周内第二次
items.desc: 73 个恶意软件包在被 AI 代理打开后立即运行自我复制型窃取器，暴露 AI 代理供应链安全风险。
items.value: AI 代理自动执行环境成为新型攻击面，供应链安全需重新评估。

items.title: Amazon 推出 AI 生成定制商品功能
items.desc: Amazon 扩展按需打印服务，用户可通过 Alexa 用文本提示生成 AI 设计，印制在 T 恤、水瓶等商品上出售。
items.value: AI 生成内容与电商深度融合，降低个性化商品创作门槛。

items.title: 原字节 Seed 团队成员顾全全回应离职争议
items.desc: 顾全全否认关于其非负责人的说法，该部门近期多人离职创业，引发行业关注。
items.value: 国内头部 AI 团队人才流动加速，创业热潮持续。

items.title: BloomBench：首个认知启发的双语多模态基准
items.desc: 该基准从人类认知角度严格诊断视觉语言模型（VLM）的真实推理能力，填补现有评估碎片化的空白。
items.value: 为 VLM 推理能力提供更严格的认知诊断工具。

items.title: CORE：对比反思实现推理能力的快速提升
items.desc: 提出非参数学习算法，通过对比过去推理轨迹生成改进信号，无需大量训练样本即可提升模型推理能力。
items.value: 低成本推理增强方法，适合资源受限场景的快速迭代。

items.title: Compress-Distill：推理轨迹压缩实现高效知识蒸馏
items.desc: 研究对推理模型的长思维链轨迹进行事后压缩，在保持性能的前提下将训练 token 量降至原来的 8.6-21.0%。
items.value: 大幅降低推理模型蒸馏成本，加速小模型部署。

items.title: Robots Need More than VLA and World Models
items.desc: 该立场论文指出机器人智能的瓶颈不仅是策略学习，更缺乏将海量非结构化行为数据转化为有监督机器人训练信号的机制。
items.value: 重新定义机器人学习的关键瓶颈，引导研究转向数据转化机制。

items.title: Imaginative Perception Tokens 增强多模态语言模型的空间推理
items.desc: 提出想象感知令牌（IPT），作为中间感知表征，帮助 VLM 推断不可直接观察的空间信息。
items.value: 解决 VLM 在空间推理中的关键短板，提升具身智能表现。

items.title: UnpredictaBench：评估 LLM 分布随机性的基准
items.desc: 测试 LLM 捕捉真实分布的能力，发现许多模型倾向于坍缩到单一答案，无法模拟真实系统的不确定性。
items.value: 揭示 LLM 在模拟、经济学等场景中的根本性缺陷。

items.title: Augmenting Attention with Exponentially Decaying Memory 提升查询感知 KV 稀疏性
items.desc: 研究发现递归增强注意力骨干 RAT+ 能显著提升现有查询感知稀疏推理方法的性能。
items.value: 为长上下文 LLM 推理加速提供新思路，降低 KV 缓存成本。

items.title: LayerRoute：基于输入的适应性层跳过机制
items.desc: 通过 LoRA 微调学习按输入选择性跳过 Transformer 块，针对 agentic 任务中结构化工具调用与开放推理步骤的异构性优化。
items.value: Agentic LLM 推理加速的实用方案，按需分配计算资源。

items.title: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
items.desc: AI agent 技能，可跨 Reddit、X、YouTube、HN、Polymarket 及网络研究任意主题，并综合生成有据可依的摘要。
items.value: 多源信息聚合 agent，适合市场研究与舆情监测。

items.title: colbymchenry/codegraph
items.desc: 预索引的代码知识图谱，支持 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini、Cursor 等主流 AI 编码工具，减少 token 消耗和工具调用次数。
items.value: 显著提升 AI 编码工具的上下文理解效率，降低使用成本。

items.title: alibaba/open-code-review
items.desc: 阿里巴巴开源的混合架构代码审查工具，结合确定性流水线与 LLM Agent，提供精确的行级注释和内置规则集。
items.value: 经阿里大规模验证的代码审查方案，可直接用于生产环境。

items.title: chopratejas/headroom
items.desc: 在到达 LLM 之前压缩工具输出、日志、文件和 RAG 块，减少 60-95% token 量而答案不变，提供库、代理和 MCP 服务器三种使用方式。
items.value: 大幅降低 LLM 调用成本，适合高频 agent 应用。

items.title: XingYu-Zhong/DeepSeek-GUI
items.desc: 针对 DeepSeek 模型的 AI agent 工作空间，内置 Code 和 Claw 模式，可直接嵌入应用程序。
items.value: 为 DeepSeek 模型提供完整的图形化 agent 开发环境。

items.title: Panniantong/Agent-Reach
items.desc: 让 AI agent 拥有"眼睛"浏览整个互联网，支持 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、Bilibili、小红书等平台，单 CLI 零 API 费用。
items.value: 零成本的跨平台信息获取方案，极大扩展 agent 能力边界。

items.title: alchaincyf/huashu-design
items.desc: Claude Code 的 HTML 原生设计 skill，支持高保真原型、幻灯片、动画制作，内置 20 项设计哲学和 5 维评审体系。
items.value: 将设计能力注入 AI 编码 agent，实现从代码到视觉的一体化。

items.title: openai/plugins
items.desc: OpenAI 官方插件仓库，为 ChatGPT 等产品提供第三方扩展能力。
items.value: OpenAI 生态扩展的官方入口，开发者可直接集成。

items.title: RyanCodrai/turbovec
items.desc: 基于 TurboQuant 的向量索引，Rust 编写并提供 Python 绑定，追求高性能向量检索。
items.value: 高性能向量检索方案，适合对延迟敏感的应用场景。

items.title: Leonxlnx/taste-skill
items.desc: 名为"品味技能"的前端工具，旨在阻止 AI 生成无聊、通用的"垃圾内容"，赋予 AI 良好的审美判断。
items.value: 解决 AI 输出同质化问题，提升生成内容的品质与多样性。

en.headline: Bun Team Rewrites 1M Lines of Code with Claude Code in 9 Days, Sparking Security Concerns
en.observation: The core signal today is that the AI industry is shifting from a "capability race" to a "trust and safety race." Bun's million-line Claude Code rewrite sparking security concerns, Microsoft packages being infected with credential stealers for the second time, and Meta being forced to remove facial recognition code all remind the industry that scaled AI deployment must be built on trust. Meanwhile, the OpenAI and Anthropic IPO race, alongside Apple WWDC's full AI upgrade, shows acceleration on both capital and product fronts — but whoever finds the balance between speed and safety will win the next phase.

items.title: OpenAI Files Confidentially for IPO, Following Anthropic
items.desc: OpenAI has confidentially submitted an S-1 filing with the SEC, just one week after its main rival Anthropic filed to go public, escalating the IPO race between the two AI giants.
items.value: AI industry capitalization accelerates as two leading firms compete for public market first-mover advantage.

items.title: Bun Team Rewrites 1M Lines of Code with Claude Code in 9 Days, Sparking Security Concerns
items.desc: The Bun project completed its largest-ever AI refactoring with 6,755 commits, but the developer community is debating whether a 99.8% test pass rate truly represents code safety.
items.value: Extreme case of AI code refactoring exposes gap between test coverage and security.

items.title: Apple WWDC 2026 Unveils New Siri AI and Apple Intelligence Upgrades
items.desc: Apple introduced an AI-powered new Siri at WWDC with more natural conversation, personalized context understanding, and announced free cloud AI API access for small developers.
items.value: Apple's AI strategy fully deployed, lowering developer barriers and accelerating ecosystem AI apps.

items.title: Google NotebookLM Upgraded to Gemini 3.5 with Cloud Computer and Source Retrieval
items.desc: NotebookLM gets a full upgrade to the Gemini 3.5 model with more accurate responses, plus new cloud computing capabilities and source-finding features.
items.value: AI note-taking tool leaps from passive Q&A to active research assistant.

items.title: Microsoft AI Chief Says Superintelligence Is Near, But Won't Take Your Job
items.desc: Mustafa Suleyman stated in an interview that superintelligence is imminent but human jobs won't be fully replaced, emphasizing a future of human-AI collaboration.
items.value: Top AI executive's authoritative take on AGI timeline and employment impact.

items.title: Ant Group Launches Overseas AI Payment Solution for Global Agent Operations
items.desc: The solution helps users and merchants assess agent trustworthiness, paving the way for commercialized AI agent payments.
items.value: Payment infrastructure for the AI agent economy, solving trust and settlement issues.

items.title: Amap Releases ABot-Earth0.5: 3D-Native High-Consistency Scene Generation Model
items.desc: The model moves beyond 2D distillation to native 3D for high-consistency scene generation, now open for beta testing.
items.value: 3D scene generation shifts from 2D distillation to native 3D, improving realism for autonomous driving simulation.

items.title: UK Government Invests $1 Billion in AI Supercomputer to Reduce US Tech Dependence
items.desc: The UK believes state-backed computing infrastructure will boost domestic chip startups and reduce reliance on American technology.
items.value: Global AI compute race intensifies as countries accelerate localization efforts.

items.title: Meta Removes Face-Recognition System from Its Smart Glasses App
items.desc: Following a WIRED report, Meta deleted facial recognition code from the latest Meta AI app without explaining why or whether it will return.
items.value: AI privacy regulation tightens as facial recognition faces increased scrutiny.

items.title: Microsoft Packages Laced with Credential Stealer for Second Time in Weeks
items.desc: 73 malicious packages run self-replicating stealers as soon as opened by an AI agent, exposing AI supply chain security risks.
items.value: AI agent auto-execution environments become new attack surface; supply chain security needs reassessment.

items.title: Amazon Launches AI-Generated Custom Merch Feature
items.desc: Amazon expands print-on-demand services, letting users generate AI designs via Alexa text prompts for T-shirts, water bottles, and other products.
items.value: AI-generated content deeply integrated with e-commerce, lowering barriers to personalized product creation.

items.title: Former ByteDance Seed Team Member Gu Quanquan Responds to Departure Controversy
items.desc: Gu denied claims about not being a team lead, as multiple members from the department recently left to start ventures.
items.value: Talent flow accelerates at top Chinese AI teams; entrepreneurial wave continues.

items.title: BloomBench: First Cognitively-Inspired Bilingual Multimodal Benchmark
items.desc: This benchmark rigorously diagnoses real reasoning abilities of VLMs from a human cognitive perspective, filling gaps in fragmented existing evaluations.
items.value: Provides stricter cognitive diagnostic tools for VLM reasoning capabilities.

items.title: CORE: Contrastive Reflection Enables Rapid Reasoning Improvements
items.desc: Proposes a non-parametric learning algorithm that compares past reasoning traces to generate improvement signals, boosting reasoning without requiring large training samples.
items.value: Low-cost reasoning enhancement method suitable for resource-constrained rapid iteration.

items.title: Compress-Distill: Reasoning Trace Compression for Efficient Knowledge Distillation
items.desc: Studies post-hoc compression of long chain-of-thought traces from reasoning models, reducing training tokens to 8.6-21.0% of original while maintaining performance.
items.value: Dramatically reduces reasoning model distillation costs, accelerating small model deployment.

items.title: Robots Need More than VLA and World Models
items.desc: This position paper argues the bottleneck in robot intelligence is not just policy learning but the lack of mechanisms to convert abundant unstructured behavioral data into grounded robot supervision.
items.value: Redefines key bottleneck in robot learning, redirecting research toward data transformation mechanisms.

items.title: Imaginative Perception Tokens Enhance Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Language Models
items.desc: Proposes IPT as intermediate perceptual representations to help VLMs infer spatial information not directly observable.
items.value: Addresses key VLM weakness in spatial reasoning, improving embodied AI performance.

items.title: UnpredictaBench: Benchmark for Evaluating Distributional Randomness in LLMs
items.desc: Tests LLMs' ability to capture true underlying distributions, finding many models collapse to single answers and fail to simulate real system uncertainty.
items.value: Reveals fundamental LLM flaws in simulation and economics scenarios.

items.title: Augmenting Attention with Exponentially Decaying Memory Improves Query-Aware KV Sparsity
items.desc: Research finds recurrence-augmented attention backbone RAT+ significantly improves existing query-aware sparse inference methods.
items.value: New approach for long-context LLM inference acceleration, reducing KV cache costs.

items.title: LayerRoute: Input-Conditioned Adaptive Layer Skipping via LoRA Fine-Tuning
items.desc: Learns to selectively skip Transformer blocks per input, optimizing for heterogeneity between structured tool calls and open-ended reasoning in agentic tasks.
items.value: Practical inference acceleration for agentic LLMs, allocating compute on demand.

items.title: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
items.desc: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web, then synthesizes a grounded summary.
items.value: Multi-source information aggregation agent for market research and sentiment monitoring.

items.title: colbymchenry/codegraph
items.desc: Pre-indexed code knowledge graph supporting Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, and other major AI coding tools, reducing token consumption and tool calls.
items.value: Significantly improves context understanding efficiency for AI coding tools, lowering usage costs.

items.title: alibaba/open-code-review
items.desc: Alibaba's open-source hybrid architecture code review tool combining deterministic pipelines with LLM Agent, providing precise line-level comments and built-in rule sets.
items.value: Battle-tested code review solution at Alibaba scale, ready for production use.

items.title: chopratejas/headroom
items.desc: Compresses tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before reaching the LLM, reducing tokens by 60-95% with same answers. Available as library, proxy, and MCP server.
items.value: Drastically reduces LLM call costs, ideal for high-frequency agent applications.

items.title: XingYu-Zhong/DeepSeek-GUI
items.desc: AI agent workspace for DeepSeek models with built-in Code and Claw modes, embeddable into applications.
items.value: Provides a complete graphical agent development environment for DeepSeek models.

items.title: Panniantong/Agent-Reach
items.desc: Gives AI agents "eyes" to browse the entire internet, supporting Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, and more — one CLI, zero API fees.
items.value: Zero-cost cross-platform information access, vastly expanding agent capability boundaries.

items.title: alchaincyf/huashu-design
items.desc: HTML-native design skill for Claude Code supporting high-fidelity prototypes, slides, and animations with 20 design philosophies and a 5-dimension review system.
items.value: Injects design capability into AI coding agents, enabling code-to-visual integration.

items.title: openai/plugins
items.desc: OpenAI's official plugin repository, providing third-party extension capabilities for ChatGPT and other products.
items.value: Official entry point for OpenAI ecosystem expansion, ready for developer integration.

items.title: RyanCodrai/turbovec
items.desc: Vector index built on TurboQuant, written in Rust with Python bindings, pursuing high-performance vector retrieval.
items.value: High-performance vector retrieval solution for latency-sensitive applications.

items.title: Leonxlnx/taste-skill
items.desc: A "taste skill" frontend tool designed to stop AI from generating boring, generic "slop," giving AI good aesthetic judgment.
items.value: Addresses AI output homogenization, improving content quality and diversity.
